source_verification_receipts.locator: official proceedings record; associated manuscript p. 7, immediately before Theorems 4--5
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper states that Algorithm 1 is sound, proves nonidentification for failures at Algorithm 1 lines 4 and 14 and Algorithm 2 line 3, and explicitly conjectures completeness.
The paper adds observational positivity to gID, gives a sound and complete algorithm, and reduces the problem to classical ID subproblems.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1--3, abstract, contribution summary, and Definition 3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a sound and complete procedure for CSI relations restricted to observed root control variables.
The paper supplies an ID algorithm for recursive semi-Markovian models, proves termination, and gives the classical formula-or-hedge completeness setting.
The paper establishes a finite canonical SCM family counterfactually equivalent to arbitrary categorical SCMs and uses it for polynomial-program bounds.
The paper gives sufficient data-fusion pruning and clustering conditions and transports do-calculus identifying functionals from reduced graphs to original graphs.
The paper derives influence-function/weight-based estimators for identified hidden-variable graphical effects, including a complete identifier that yields a weight-based estimation strategy.
The paper presents do-search, a sound search procedure for identification from incomplete observational and experimental sources, and its R package implementation.
